integrity: All assertions have an explicit self-contained mathematical argument in RESULT.md, corroborated by a standalone standard-library verifier. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
limitations: The general vertex-cover expansion requires a finite isolate-free simple base graph; the four-class inclusion-minimal enumeration requires complete bipartite graphs with both shore sizes at least two with a,b>=2. Exhaustive numerical tests cover finite instances, not all orders. Publication-priority comparisons are provisional and do not amount to independent certification.
title: Total-domination enumerators of edge-triangulated graphs and sparse minimal spectra
